verdict.reasoning: Rendered PDF page 55 (printed page 31) at 300 dpi shows Figure 1 as a ruler of cells 1..13 and '...': Margin L bar at the left of cell 1, Margin C bar on the boundary between 6 and 7, Margin A bar on the boundary between 7 and 8, Margin R bar at the right of '...'; a brace under 1-6 labelled 'Sequence Number Area', a downward arrow to 7 labelled 'Indicator Area', and a brace under 8 through '...' labelled 'Program-text Area'. The markdown table puts 'Margin C' in the column of cell 6 and 'Margin A' in the column of cell 8 (on cells, not boundaries), merges 9-13 into one cell, and emits the area labels as detached text in the wrong order ('Program-text Area Sequence Number Area' then 'Indicator Area') with no span association. The claim quotes both sources accurately. The figure's content (which positions form which area, where the margins fall) is lost from the transcription of the figure itself; the normative prose immediately below restates all of it correctly, so the defect is structural, not normative.
